messages:
Noah Bennett: FYI since ~07:18 UTC we started seeing onboarding callbacks rejected with 422 from customer endpoints for Private deployments. Impact: activations showing as failed, backfill paused. Ive identified 9 tenants where the callback payload fails schema validation. Need a comms + enablement and replay plan. @Claire can you draft a short status note?

Claire O'Neill: On it. Will keep it plain and include next steps. Draft below for review.

Claire O'Neill: Hi <Customer> \u2014 were investigating failed onboarding callbacks for your Private deployment. Some callbacks are being rejected by destination endpoints due to a recent change in our webhook payload schema. Weve rolled a temporary compatibility fix and expect activations to complete within 24 hours. If your trial expiry is approaching, reply here and well pause expiry while we finish replays. For urgent replays, reply or email cs@redwood.com. We will follow up with a technical RCA and any applicable credits.  Claire, Redwood CS

Victor Huang: Tech context: we tightened the payload (removed legacy meta.* fields) in rollout-2026-03-25. Some customer endpoints still validate presence of those fields and return 422. I pushed a short-term shim that injects legacy fields for affected tenants and re-enabled the backfill. Will produce a longer-term safer schema migration plan.

Priyanka Rao: ETA for backlog drain? Any risk of duplicate processing?

Victor Huang: Backlog drain ETA ~1580min per tenant depending on queue. Deliveries are idempotent but some customer systems are not; for those we'll coordinate manual replays and provide a signed idempotency header to help de-dupe. No data loss expected.

Noah Bennett: Good. Claire, add a line about idempotency header and trial pause option. Also flag renewal-risk: mark tenants with activations >48h as "renewal-monitor".

Claire O'Neill: Updated draft to include idempotency header note and trial pause. Sending in two small batches so we can monitor replies.

cs-bot: [action] compatibility-shim enabled for tenants: 9 by Victor Huang  job=shim-561 status=success

Claire O'Neill: Posting first batch now. Message copy: ```Hi there  we detected failed onboarding callbacks for your Private deployment due to a webhook payload schema mismatch. Weve applied a temporary compatibility shim and will replay queued activations; most tenants should finish within 24 hours. Were adding an idempotency header to replays to avoid duplicates. If your trial expires soon, reply here to request a pause. For urgent help email cs@redwood.com. Well follow up with an RCA and any credits if SLA impacted.  Claire, Redwood CS```

Victor Huang: Internal manual replay instructions (CS/Enablement):
```
# manual replay steps
1) POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: replay-{ts}-{tenant_id}"
2) tail logs: kubectl -n vpc-{tenant_id} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
3) confirm delivery: SELECT status, response_code, ts FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
4) if customer returns 422, escalate to Victor for per-payload transform
```

Priyanka Rao: Ill open 45min office hours at 10:00 UTC for any tenants needing live replays. Victor, can you join for payload transforms?

Victor Huang: Yes 10:0010:45 UTC. Ill bring sample payload transforms and a small script to inject legacy fields when safe.

Noah Bennett: Renewal owners: well put any tenant with activation >48h into renewal-monitor and draft tailored outreach. Priyanka please add CRM flags and link to office hours in the customer note.

Claire O'Neill: Done  added CRM flag "onboard-schema-replay" and office-hours link to messages. Also included a 1-question feedback survey in follow-up: "Was the replay/communication satisfactory? Yes/No + comment"

cs-bot: [notice] replay-jobs queued: tenants=9 job=replay-shim-2026-03-25 status=queued

Victor Huang: Early replays show most deliveries 200; two tenants still returning 422 due to strict schema validators. Im preparing per-tenant transforms and will run manual replays for those.

Priyanka Rao: Ill track renewal-watch candidates and prepare the renewal-owner script for any tenant crossing 36h. Please ping me for any high-touch accounts.

Noah Bennett: Action list recap: Claire send customer batches (done/in progress), Victor do per-tenant transforms + RCA (ETA today EOD), Priyanka KB + office hours + CRM flags (in progress), Noah exec summary + renewal queue handoff. Add anything else here.

Claire O'Neill: Sending follow-up message after replays with survey link and offer to pause trial if needed.

Victor Huang: Posting telemetry + sample payload diffs to the RCA doc later today. Will include suggested migration steps for customers.
